tie_rules_pinned.DEGREE_FLAGS_TIEBREAK_GUESS_THEN_CHECK: sort every node of each world by (in-degree, out-degree, flag_position, rank), all ascending; pair the two sorted lists; one check of every edge
tie_rules_pinned.DEGREE_WHOLE_CHILD_FLAGS_GUESS_THEN_CHEC: sort by (in-degree, out-degree, 1 - child_of_the_declared_whole, flag_position, rank), all ascending (children before non-children); pair; one check of every edge
sort by (in-degree, out-degree, child_of_the_declared_whole, flag_position, rank), all ascending (non-children before children); pair; one check of every edge
tie_rules_pinned.bank_rule: analogy: each rule makes that one guess for each same-degree, other-domain candidate in displayed-alias order (sorted world_id) and answers the first candidate whose guess passes, else NO_MATCH; no backtracking, no second guess per candidate
tie_rules_pinned.child_of_the_declared_whole: 1 if an edge runs from the declared whole (declarations.participants[0]) to the node, else 0 (the whole itself is 0)
tie_rules_pinned.flag_position: the node's index in declarations.participants: 0 = the declared whole, 1 = the second declared participant, 2 = the third; 3 = every node that is not a declared participant; ascending (whole first)
tie_rules_pinned.one_guess_family: DEGREE_GUESS_THEN_CHECK, WHOLE_ANCHOR_GUESS_THEN_CHECK, FLAG_ANCHOR_GUESS_THEN_CHECK: map the first 0, 1 or 3 declared participants in order, then pair the other nodes sorted by (in-degree, out-degree, rank), all ascending; one check of every edge
tie_rules_pinned.rank: a node's rank is its position in the world's sorted node references (ascending); lowest rank first
tie_rules_pinned.the_check: 'check all required relations and flags' (A2.7 D2) is read as checker v2's own condition: every edge maps onto an edge and the counts agree (checker_v2._isomorphisms: 'node labels, root choice and archetypes do not vote'); the declared domain is checked by the candidate filter; declared flags are not a required relation of an analogy or correspondence answer, so they order the guess but are not checked
